## Unified AI System (preview)

Unified AI System is a self-hosted AI gateway; this image is its MCP preview. On start it launches an isolated gateway on container loopback that is pinned to a deterministic fake provider, so it needs no credentials, calls no model provider, and the MCP surface refuses any gateway that could call a real one. The useful part in ToolHive is local, provider-free tooling: `gateway_prompt_enhance` turns a plain-language request into a structured prompt (task profile, output language, optional plan-verify-report protocol for agents), `workflow_run` executes a three-step local workflow that writes one artifact inside the container, and read-only tools report gateway, knowledge, workflow, workforce and agent-governance status. `gateway_chat` returns fake responses only; it demonstrates the fail-closed provider check and does not generate useful text. Typical workflow: `thv run unified-ai-system`, connect your MCP client through ToolHive, and ask it to structure a request with `gateway_prompt_enhance` before handing the result to the model you already use. The image is pinned to its linux/amd64 manifest; the 0.8.0 arm64 variant ships x86-64 native modules and is not supported (happy520ai/unified-ai-system#190).
